name: totem
description: Know which world you're in: each Claude Code session wears its project's totem, a color across the whole terminal, a big pixel name above the prompt, and a live radar of your other sessions.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: big: the project's name in 3-row pixel letters. bar: one colored line. off: nothing.

tint.title: Tint the terminal
tint.description: Wash the terminal background in the project's color while the session runs.

title.title: Own the tab title
title.description: Name the tab after the project (emoji, name, state) instead of the task summary.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: full: arrival reveal, a sweep when Claude needs you, and fades. calm: fades only. off: no animation.

ai.title: Let Claude pick the totem
ai.description: The first time a project opens, ask a small model for an emoji and hue that fit it. Off: picked from a hash of the path.

nudges.title: Nudges from other sessions
nudges.description: A toast in the session you are looking at when another one needs you, or finishes a turn longer than 30 seconds.
